title: parse_request loses serde detail in notRequest error
description: parse_request line 32: .map_err(|_| JmapError::not_request()) silently discards the serde error. When operators debug malformed client requests, they have no machine-readable detail — only the 'notRequest' type. Suggested rewrite: JmapError::not_request_with_detail(e.to_string()) or pass e into description. The serde message ('missing field methodCalls at ...') is useful to clients without leaking server internals. RFC 8620 §3.6.1 allows but does not require a description field.
